title: Watercolor Warriors
content: (Direct link to video) Painting outdoors with watercolor is a tough challenge, even for highly trained professionals. In this episode Jeanette and I square off against dangerous wasps, rain, and wind in an attempt to paint an abandoned farm tractor.Tools:Schmincke Watercolor Pocket Set,Caran D'Ache watercolor pencils,Moleskine Watercolor Notebook, and a 1/4 inch flat watercolor travel brush,Matthews Century Stand,Artist Umbrellaanda fridge super magnet(thanks,Steve), shot on aCanon VIXIA.Check out myother videos or subscribe to the GurneyJourney YouTube channelso you can see new videos before anyone else.
